description: This file implements the 'git replay' builtin command, including functions for retrieving commit information, creating commits, handling reference updates, and executing the replay process with options for advancing branches or replaying onto specific commits. It manages revs, commits, references, and merging operations to facilitate replaying commit histories in a Git repository.

classes.name: ref_info
classes.description: Structure holding information about references involved in the replay operation, including the onto commit and sets of positive and negative references.

methods.name: const char * short_commit_name(struct repository * repo,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Returns a short, unique abbreviation for a given commit within a repository.

methods.name: struct:commit * peel_committish(struct repository * repo,const char * name)
methods.description: Resolves a commit name to a commit object, peeling if necessary.

methods.name: char * get_author(const char * message)
methods.description: Extracts the author header from a commit message.

methods.name: struct:commit * create_commit(struct repository * repo,struct tree * tree,struct commit * based_on,struct commit * parent)
methods.description: Creates a new commit object in the repository with specified parameters.

methods.name: void get_ref_information(struct repository * repo,struct rev_cmdline_info * cmd_info,struct ref_info * ref_info)
methods.description: Analyzes command line arguments to determine references involved in the replay.

methods.name: void determine_replay_mode(struct repository * repo,struct rev_cmdline_info * cmd_info,const char * onto_name,char ** advance_name,struct commit ** onto,struct strset ** update_refs)
methods.description: Determines the replay mode based on user input and repository state, resolving references for the operation.

methods.name: struct:commit * mapped_commit(kh_oid_map_t * replayed_commits,struct commit * commit,struct commit * fallback)
methods.description: Retrieves the mapped commit corresponding to an original commit, fallback if not found.

methods.name: struct:commit * pick_regular_commit(struct repository * repo,struct commit * pickme,kh_oid_map_t * replayed_commits,struct commit * onto,struct merge_options * merge_opt,struct merge_result * result)
methods.description: Replays a commit, merging as necessary, and creates the replayed commit.

methods.name: enum:ref_action_mode parse_ref_action_mode(const char * ref_action,const char * source)
methods.description: Parses a string into a reference action mode enum.

methods.name: enum:ref_action_mode get_ref_action_mode(struct repository * repo,const char * ref_action)
methods.description: Determines the reference action mode from command line or configuration.

methods.name: int handle_ref_update(enum ref_action_mode mode,struct ref_transaction * transaction,const char * refname,const struct object_id * new_oid,const struct object_id * old_oid,const char * reflog_msg,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Performs the update or print of a reference depending on the mode.

methods.name: int cmd_replay(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main function implementing the 'git replay' command, parsing options, managing revisions, performing the replay, and updating references.
